subject: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Brophy <susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: procure@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option

Hi Susan / Zephyr procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Zephyr onboarded. I’m gathering the remaining items for vendor setup and want to align on two operational points that affect invoicing cadence:

1) PO and invoice cutoff window. Our finance system consumes POs and invoices in daily batches; we typically require invoices to be submitted by the PO cutoff for the month to be included in that cycle. For most enterprise customers we align on either the 1st/15th or the 10th/25th cutoff cadence. Which of those aligns to Zephyr’s AP calendar?

2) Early-pay / discount option. Zephyr mentioned interest in early-pay discounts during the procurement call. We can offer a vendor early-pay enrollment (1.5% discount if Redwood remits within 15 days) for the pilot engagement and handle enrollment as part of onboarding if your AP team signs off.

I’ve attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and the W9 stub so we can close the set. Can you confirm: preferred PO cutoff (pick one), whether you want the 15-day early-pay opt-in, and the PO number we should link for the first invoice?

If you prefer I can loop Finance (Ben Carter) and Procurement Ops (Priyom Das) for a short sync — 20 minutes should do it.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Supplier Ops | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-2198
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: W9-Zephyr.pdf (PDF)]

From: Susan Brophy <susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option

Thanks Olga — quick answers from our side:

- PO cutoff: Zephyr currently runs a 10th / 25th invoice cutoff. That would be ideal for our AP team.
- Early-pay: Yes — we are open to a 15-day early-pay program at 1.5% discount, but procurement needs the terms documented and approval from our VP Finance (I’ll route).
- First PO: Please reference PO-000987 (attached to this reply for your intake).

I’ve attached the signed PO and the procurement contact for any additional KYC. We’ll expect Redwood to bill against the PO number; can you confirm how Redwood will handle remittance and accounting codes so our AP can reconcile?

Regards,
Susan Brophy
Sr. Procurement Manager, Zephyr Health Systems
susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com | +1 617-555-0124
[Attachment: PO-000987.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Brophy <susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option

Susan — perfect, thanks for the fast reply and the PO. Confirming next steps so we have an auditable trail: 

- We will set Zephyr to the 10th/25th invoice cadence in our billing system. Invoices received before the cutoff will be included in the next settlement run.
- Early-pay: Subject to VP Finance approval on Zephyr side — if approved, Redwood will enroll Zephyr in the 15-day early-pay program with a 1.5% gross discount applied at settlement. Redwood will issue a reconciled remittance advice that includes the gross invoice, discount applied, and net paid.
- Accounting codes / remittance: Redwood remits via ACH to the bank details on the W9 and provides an XML remittance file for your AP portal. We’ll include the PO number and our internal invoice reference on every transaction.

I’ve copied Ben (Finance) and Priyom (Procurement Ops) to confirm internal readiness and to propose a short 20-minute call Wednesday to finalize the enrollment and onboarding checklist.

Action items for Zephyr: please confirm VP Finance approval for the early-pay enrollment by EOD Tuesday so we can include that in Wednesday’s call.

Best,
Olga
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Brophy <susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option

Adding Finance confirmation here. A few notes from our side for the enrollment and for Zephyr’s procurement team: 

- Eligibility: Early-pay at 1.5% is available for first-year vendor relationships and requires the W9 and a signed MSA (we have the signed MSA on file for this deal).
- Cutoffs: Redwood’s settlement runs are tied to the vendor’s chosen cutoff; the 10th/25th cadence is fine. Invoices posted after the cutoff will roll to the next run — please ensure Zephyr’s AP sends PDFs to invoices@redwood.ai with PO in subject line.
- Discount accounting: We will record the discount as a contracted reduction to gross revenue and provide the remittance advice showing gross, discount, and net paid. For Zephyr’s reconciliation, look for the remittance XML which includes the payment date, PO, invoice refs, and discount lines.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-3003

P.S. Priyom — can your team confirm we have the vendor tax country and banking details locked from the W9? If not, we’ll hold early-pay until banking verification completes.

From: Susan Brophy <susan.brophy@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Zephyr Health onboarding: PO cutoff windows and early-pay option

Thanks all — quick update from our side: VP Finance signed off on the 15-day early-pay at 1.5% (approval attached). Bank details on the W9 are confirmed — I’ve also asked our AP team to start sending invoices to invoices@redwood.ai with PO-000987 in the subject line.

We’re good to proceed with the 10th/25th cadence. Let’s run the short sync at 11am PT Thursday to finalize remittance format and to confirm the first billing window.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to getting this into the system.

Best,
Susan
[Attachment: VP-Finance-approval.pdf (PDF)]
